observations: Photo 0: A small portable keyboard in a pink hard case; visible white/black keys with colored note labels on some keys; case appears to be part of the set.
Photo 1: Close-up of the keyboard’s pink case; brand text on the case reads “AVANT-GARDE MUSIC” (watermark/branding overlay).
Photo 2: Side/back view of the keyboard showing the same “AVANT-GARDE MUSIC” overlay; no clear model/brand plate visible.

identity.kind: portable mini keyboard (toy/entry-level style) with hard case

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: Photos show the keyboard in a case, but no seals, serial/model label, or proof of never being opened.
No power-on/test video or audio of keys being pressed.
No receipt/warranty documents are shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong model/brand or generic mini keyboard (photos don’t show a readable model/brand plate).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the keyboard’s label/serial/model number (usually on the back/bottom) and the case label if any.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified generic mini keyboard (worst case: entry-level/low-spec).

risks.risk: Not actually working (keys may be dead, power adapter missing, or internal fault).
risks.proof: Short video: plug in/power on, press multiple keys across the range, and show any display/sound output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter/charging cable, stand, manual).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter/cable, manual, warranty/receipt if claimed).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not visible (scratches, key wobble, broken hinges/latches on the case).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: keybed surface, each case latch/hinge, and any corners/edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition (worst case: minor wear).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the keyboard’s back/bottom label showing brand + exact model/serial number.
Video test: power on and press keys across the full range (show sound/output).
Photo of included items: power adapter/cable, manual, and any warranty/receipt documents.
Close-ups of case latches/hinges and any visible wear on the keyboard and case.
response.reason: The photos show a portable mini keyboard in a case, but the exact model/brand and working status cannot be confirmed remotely, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the decisive proof (model label + power-on test).
